mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, user_id, order_no, amount, pay_status, pay_method, pay_txn_no, paid_at, visit_time, items, created_at, updated_at FROM order_record WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, shop_id, user_id, order_no, amount, pay_status, pay_method, pay_txn_no, paid_at, visit_time, items, created_at, updated_at FROM order_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY visit_time DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_record (shop_id, user_id, order_no, amount, pay_status, visit_time, items, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{userId}, #{orderNo}, #{amount}, COALESCE(#{payStatus}, 0), #{visitTime}, #{items}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE order_record SET pay_status = 1, pay_method = #{payMethod}, pay_txn_no = #{payTxnNo}, paid_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND pay_status = 0
UPDATE order_record SET pay_status = 2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND pay_status = 0
